logp.method_description: FMP and DFMP were dissolved in PBS containing DMSO (3%) at 10 μM, respectively, and kept at 37 °C for 48 h. The UV–vis absorption spectra of the complexes were determined at 0, 24, and 48 h, respectively, after subtracting the baseline of PBS containing 0.3% DMSO. N-octanol–water partition coefficients (Log Po/w) were calculated according to a reported procedure. (13) Log Po/w is defined as the logarithmic ratio (Log Po/w = Log Ao/Aw) of FMP or DFMP concentration in n-octanol to that in aqueous phase.
